full_judgment: 7. Assailing the impugned judgment of the High Court Division Mr. A. J. Mohammad Ali has mainly argued that the High Court Division has erred in not believing the patta a more than 30 years old document as genuine for the reason that no competent witness came before court to prove this pasta without considering at all the fact that this patta being a very old document of the year 1913 AD none was available to give evidence in support of execution of this patta executed in the year 1913 AD; that the High Court Division did not take into consideration the fact also that though no person could be produced before the trial court to prove the genuineness of this patta but there were some other most dependable evidence which supported the genuineness of this patta, that the CS. khatian, R.S. khatian and also the rent receipts showing payment of rent by the plaintiffs and their predecessors supported the genuineness of this patta, but the revisional court did not take into consideration all these valuable documentary evidence at all.
